Class Product

  • Constructor Details

    • Product

      public Product()
      Creates an empty product instance for Jackson deserialization.

    • Product

      public Product (int productId, String name, double price, boolean onSale, Double discountPrice, int stock, byte[] productImage, String fileName, String contentType, int fileSize)
      Creates a product with its core pricing data and optional attached file metadata.
      Parameters:
      productId - the product identifier
      name - the product name
      price - the regular product price
      onSale - whether the product is currently on sale
      discountPrice - the sale price when the product is on sale, otherwise null
      stock - the available stock quantity
      productImage - the optional attached file bytes
      fileName - the attached file name when file data is present
      contentType - the type of the attached file when file data is present
      fileSize - the attached file size in bytes when file data is present
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the discount or file-related values are invalid
